title: Scheme Saathi signature ablation
description: Compare direct LLM eligibility from retrieved text versus the rule engine (count boundary errors). Also compare planned question order versus a fixed questionnaire for the same persona.
note: Development rule-engine scoring for boundary personas is available now via scripts/evaluate_eligibility_dev.py. The LLM-side and questioning ablations remain blocked.
code_only_results_dev: scripts/evaluate_interview_ablation_dev.py: 31 dev cases, 0 en/hi/mr verdict breaks, mean questions planned 4.19 vs fixed 5.35 (simulated citizen answers parsed by production parser; no LLM). Held-out and LLM-eligibility arms still pending.
offline_code: eval/harness/e4_shadow.py (isolated, non-authoritative shadow proposal vs rule engine; planned vs fixed question order), tested in tests/test_e4_shadow.py. The shadow proposer is a scripted stub, so its agreement (14 of 43) is a wiring check, not a measure of an LLM.
blocker: A live LLM arm that sees retrieved scheme text, and the held-out personas (Role 5), are still required for the final E4 claim.
